name: @comvivati/backend
description: Backend da plataforma Comunidade Viva e Eficaz — Monorepo com NestJS, Fastify, DDD, Clean Architecture e SOLID.
author: Comunidade Viva e Eficaz — Departamento de TI

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:oxlint && pnpm run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec oxfmt . && pnpm run lint:oxlint:fix && pnpm run lint:eslint:fix
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run test
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run cloudflare:typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm knip && pnpm run audit && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run build && pnpm run cloudflare:check && pnpm run build:size
scripts.check:push: pnpm knip && pnpm run audit && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:size
scripts.fix: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:oxlint:fix && pnpm run lint:eslint:fix
scripts.graph:deps: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('reports', { recursive: true })" && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot apps packages > reports/dependencies.dot && dot -Tsvg reports/dependencies.dot -o reports/dependencies.svg
scripts.cloudflare:check: pnpm --dir apps/bff cloudflare:check && pnpm --dir apps/core-api cloudflare:check
scripts.cloudflare:typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/bff cloudflare:typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/core-api cloudflare:typecheck
scripts.container:build: pnpm run container:build:bff && pnpm run container:build:core-api
